reason: My clients hire an architect who already gives them drawings, and nobody has ever asked to see the house before it's built. I sell with photos of finished homes, so I can't see what this would do for me.
objection: I don't see a need. My buyers have never asked for this, and I'm in the truck all day with no time to sit through a lunch demo and then check whether the model is accurate.
would_change_my_mind: A client or architect I work with asking me for a walkthrough, or a clear case of it winning me a job or avoiding a change order that cost more than $1,500.
